review_description: Although I had quotes from two companies recommended by SolarQuotes, I went with the one local to my area as I knew customers who had used his company and had no problems.Richard called around personally to do the site inspection, explained the system they would install and why they use that product and was very knowledgeable without being pushy.The quote was emailed within a few hours and over the next couple of days I did more research on the product he quoted on, sent emails with questions that I had and always received prompt responses.The quote, although not the cheapest was within what I was prepared to pay and very competitive with the two other companies sent by SolarQuotes.Once I accepted the quote, everything went smoothly- beginning with the contact from Ergon to the actual installation and helping me set up the wifi to monitor how much power was being generated.I received my first Power bill yesterday and was very pleased with the reading for my Solar input and the $$ I am saving.

Reasonably priced compared to other companies.I have used Energy Rich on a previous house and never had a problem with the system and I certainly don't anticipate any problems this time. But, if something does happen to go wrong, they are local and are able to carry out repairs.
